The traefik is running with traefik-no-tls.yaml presumably since PORKBUN empty. But the errors about ACME suggest it's using the tls config? Let me check. Actually the labels in compose set entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}. When we ran manually via docker compose directly (not through just), the env vars weren't set, so it defaulted to websecure and traefik.yaml. But we restarted reverse-proxy via `docker compose up -d reverse-proxy` (not via just), so it may have used defaults. Let me restart using just _compose to get proper env.

Actually, wait - I restarted reverse-proxy with plain docker compose, which would use defaults: traefik.yaml (TLS) and websecure entrypoint. But the running one still shows ACME errors. Let me check which config is loaded. But actually infra-up originally via just used the right env for reverse-proxy (it started successfully in the first infra-up run). Then I recreated it with plain docker compose in the loop. Let me re-recreate with just.

Let me use just _compose to bring up reverse-proxy.

Also, let's check traefik entrypoints. The dev-services router uses entryPoints: [web]. So need traefik-no-tls config with web entrypoint on port 3000.

Let me restart reverse-proxy via just.
